settings.title: Timeline Export
settings.subtitle: Download your timeline notifications as a file.
settings.categoriesHint: Leave all unticked to include every category.
settings.downloadFallback: If nothing happened, use one of the links above. Hold down Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) while you click a link, otherwise it may not open, for example in Chrome. You can also use Copy to clipboard.
settings.accessIntro: On newer Homey Pro models an app may not read the timeline by itself. Create an API key in the Homey web app under Settings → API Keys, give it access to read notifications only, and paste it here.
settings.ready: __count__ notifications are ready. The file downloads or opens in a new window. The links below work until __expires__.
settings.openLocal: Open on the local network instead
settings.lifetimeHint: Applies to downloads from this page and to exports from Flows. Anyone who has a link can open the file until it expires, so only choose a long lifetime if you need it.
settings.triggerOnManual: Also start the Flow card for exports from this page
settings.triggerOnManualHint: The card "The timeline was exported" always starts for exports from Flows. Tick this to also start it when you download here.
settings.externalUnknown: No external address is known yet, so the tag "External link" stays empty. Open these settings once via remote access (away from home, or with Wi-Fi turned off on your phone) to set it.
settings.delimiterHint: Also used by Flow cards. Choose Tab if you paste the content into Excel or Google Sheets, for example from an email, to get the data in columns straight away.

errors.tokenRequired: Homey does not let apps read the timeline on their own. Add an API key in the app settings.
errors.tokenRejected: The saved API key was refused. Check that it still exists and may read notifications.
